definition: Neural network software is used to simulate, research, develop, and apply artificial neural networks, software concepts adapted from biological neural networks, and in some cases, a wider array of adaptive systems such as artificial intelligence and machine learning.
details: Neural network software is used to simulate, research, develop, and apply artificial neural networks, software concepts adapted from biological neural networks, and in some cases, a wider array of adaptive systems such as artificial intelligence and machine learning.

explainer.lead: Neural network software is the tooling used to simulate, research, develop and apply artificial neural networks. It matters because it turns network ideas into runnable, testable systems.

tiers.eli5: It's the workshop and tools you use to build and test the web-of-neurons models rather than sketching them on paper.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers rely on it to define, train and evaluate networks, and sometimes to model broader adaptive systems. A pitfall is treating the software as the model itself, when it only simulates and applies it.
tiers.paperLevel: Neural network software is defined as software used to simulate, research, develop and apply artificial neural networks and software concepts adapted from biological neural networks, and in some cases wider adaptive systems such as artificial intelligence and machine learning.

explainer.example: A researcher uses such software to define a network, run training and inspect results without writing the low-level simulation from scratch.
